title.en: An Act Establishing An Engineering District in the First District of Bukidnon and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing An Engineering District in the First District of Bukidnon and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2001/ra_9037_2001.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The municipalities comprising the First District of the Province of Bukidnon namely: Manolo Fortich, Sumilao, Baungon, Talakag, Libona, Malitbog, Kalilangan and Pangantucan are hereby constituted into an engineering district to be known as the Third Engineering District of the Province of Bukidnon.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its approval. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the maintenance and continued operation of the engineering district office shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
